opportunities.title: Main Grants

amount.raw: Up to £500,000 for research that addresses one or more of the priority questions outlined in our Strategic Review. In special cases, and by prior agreement, we accept applications for up to £750,000. Most of the grants we award are below £300,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Proposals must address one or more of the priority questions, have a clear path to impact, a clear conceptual framework, appropriate and rigorous methodology, experienced team, and offer good value for money. Individuals without formal employment, projects led by unaffiliated individuals, schools, further education colleges, undergraduates, master’s students, PhD fees, academic posts, ongoing costs, dissemination-only projects, local charities, replacement for statutory funding, local social services, requests for financial help, projects led by overseas organisations (unless UK-focused dissemination, engagement and impact plans are shown).
opportunities.summary: Funding for research that addresses one or more of the priority questions outlined in the Strategic Review. Two application deadlines a year: Spring and Autumn. Special cases may receive up to £750,000.
